components.note: 求 (seek) — the original picture of a fur coat (裘 qiú adds 衣); "seek, request" is a borrowed use. 求 sounds out 球 qiú and 救 jiù.
米 (rice) — grain and food, as in 粉 powder, 糕 cake, 精 refined: 糟 is dregs of fermented rice, then spoiled.
曹 (cáo) is a close sound clue for zāo; 曹 also in 遭 zāo and 槽 cáo.
米 (rice) — grain and food, as in 粉 powder, 糟, 精: cakes were first made from rice flour.
羔 (gāo, lamb) gives the exact sound.
阝 on the left is 阜 (steps, hill) — as in 院, 阳, 阴: 除 first meant palace steps; to step away, remove.
余 (yú) is a loose sound clue for chú; 余 also in 涂 tú, 途 tú and 徐 xú.
宀 (roof) — houses and shelter, as in 家, 安, 室: a building holds things.
谷 (valley) — a hollow that holds: 容 is to hold or allow.
易 (yì) is a loose sound clue for 踢 tī, 赐 cì and 惕 tì; the meaning "easy" comes from "change" and its early lizard picture is unproven.
扌 (hand) — hand actions, as in 打, 拿, 抱: holding on.
寺 (sì) is a loose sound clue for chí; 寺 also in 诗 shī, 待 dài, 特 tè and 等 děng.
心 (heart) — thought and feelings, as in 思, 感, 急: to think of someone.
相 (xiāng) is a close sound clue for xiǎng; 相 also in 箱 xiāng and 湘 xiāng.
扌 (hand) — hand actions, as in 打, 拿, 抱: to grip or rely on.
居 (jū) is a close sound clue for jù; 居 also in 剧 jù and 锯 jù.
⺮ (bamboo) — bamboo strips, once written on, as in 笔, 等, 管: a slip, so simple and brief.
间 (jiān) is a close sound clue for jiǎn.
单 (dān) gives sound to 弹 dàn/tán and 蝉 chán; as a word it means single, alone, a list.
飞 (fly) — simplified from 飛, a bird with spread wings.
广 (shelter) — buildings, as in 店, 床, 度: a hall or courtyard.
廷 (tíng) gives the exact sound; also in 挺 tǐng and 艇 tǐng.
必 (bì) is a close sound clue for mì; 必 also gives 密 mì and 蜜 mì.
宀 (roof) — houses and shelter, as in 家, 安, 室: hidden indoors, secret.
宓 (mì) gives the exact sound; also in 蜜 mì.
尸 (body) — originally a person seated or lying; as a radical it is in 尾 tail, 层 floor, 居 reside, 屋 house.
亻 (person) — people, as in 你, 他, 做: 体 is a person's body.
本 (root) — the root of a person, the body; the traditional form was 體 with 骨 (bone).
木 (tree) — wood, as in 树, 桌, 板: 检 first meant a wooden label or seal.
佥 (qiān) is a close sound clue for jiǎn; also in 验 yàn, 剑 jiàn, 脸 liǎn and 险 xiǎn.
日 (sun) — time and day, as in 时, 晚, 明: the sun at the top of a sprout, early morning. 早 also gives 草 cǎo and 澡 zǎo.
王 (jade) — jade and gems, as in 球, 现, 理: 玩 first meant to handle jade.
元 (yuán) is a close sound clue for wán; also in 完 wán and 院 yuàn.
夭 (yāo) is a loose sound clue for xiào; 夭 also in 妖 yāo. The bamboo top ⺮ here is a historical shape, not a meaning clue.
力 (strength) — effort, as in 办, 助, 努: tasks take effort. The top 夂 stands in for the traditional 務.
土 (earth) — ground and place, as in 地, 城, 坐: a field or open space.
昜 (yáng) is the traditional sound part, a loose clue for chǎng; the same part is in 汤 tāng, 扬 yáng and 肠 cháng.
十 (ten) — complete and wide: 博 is broad, abundant.
尃 (fū) is a loose sound clue for bó; 尃 also in 搏 bó, 薄 báo and 缚 fù.
纟 (silk thread, simplified 糸) — threads, as in 红, 经, 系: a pulled-tight cord. The top part is also in 坚 jiān (firm).
弓 (bow) — bows and stretching, as in 弯 bend, 弹 pluck, 引 draw: 张 is to draw a bow.
长 (zhǎng) is a close sound clue for zhāng.
攵 (tap, strike) — hand with stick, as in 教, 收, 改: to drive away, set free.
方 (fāng) is a close sound clue for fàng; 方 also in 房 fáng and 访 fǎng.
廾 (two hands) — hands throwing something out: 弃 is to cast away.
见 (see) — seeing and looking, as in 现, 觉, 看: 视 is to look.
礻 here is 示 (shì), the altar radical in 礼 and 神: in 视 it is the exact sound clue.
木 (tree) — wood, as in 树, 桌, 板: 概 first meant a wooden scraper that levelled grain.
既 (jì) is a close sound clue for gài; 既 also in 溉 gài and 慨 kǎi.
留 (liú) is a sound clue for 溜 liū, 榴 liú and 瘤 liú; as a word it means to stay or keep.
弋 (yì) is a loose sound clue for shì; 弋 also in 试 shì and 拭 shì.
工 (work, craft) — a craftsman's pattern, a standard.
元 (first, head) — a person with the head marked: 元 first meant the head, so first, chief, origin. 元 also gives 完 wán, 玩 wán and 院 yuàn.
皿 (dish) — oldest form: a person bending over a basin of water to see a reflection; 鉴 jiàn (mirror) adds metal. To look closely, to supervise.
犭 (animal, dog) — animals, as in 狗 dog, 猫 cat, 狂 wild: dogs guard.
讠 (speech) — words and law; 狱 first meant a lawsuit, then a prison.
斤 (axe) — chopping, as in 所, 斩: freshly cut wood is new (薪 xīn is firewood).
亲 (qīn) is a close sound clue for xīn.
疒 (sickness) — illness, as in 病 sick, 痛 pain, 疼 ache: madness is an illness.
风 (fēng, wind) gives the exact sound; also in 枫 fēng.
犭 (dog, animal) — animals, as in 狗, 猫, 猪: a wild animal.
王 (wáng) is a loose sound clue for kuáng; 王 also in 往 wǎng and 旺 wàng.
攵 (tap, strike) — hand with stick, as in 教, 改, 放: to gather by force or hand.
丩 (jiū) is only a loose sound clue for shōu.
中 (middle) — a line through the middle of a box, a centre mark. 中 gives sound to 钟 zhōng, 种 zhǒng, 忠 zhōng and 衷 zhōng.
纟 (silk thread, simplified 糸) — threads and ties, as in 红, 给, 结: a knot or button.
丑 (chǒu) is a loose sound clue for niǔ; 丑 also in 扭 niǔ and 钮 niǔ.
巾 (cloth) — cloth, as in 布, 帽, 帮: a belt of cloth with pieces hanging from it.
扌 (hand) — hand actions, as in 打, 拿, 抱: to seize.
爪 (zhǎo, claw) is a close sound clue for zhuā and fits the meaning: grab with claws.
亻 (person) — people, as in 你, 他, 做.
主 (zhǔ) is a close sound clue for zhù; also in 注 zhù and 柱 zhù, and 主 means master (a person who stays).
录 (lù) gives sound to 绿 lǜ, 禄 lù and 碌 lù; as a word it means to record.
耂 (old) — 老 pictures an old person with long hair leaning on a staff; the short form 耂 is also in 考 test and 孝 filial.
页 (head) — heads and faces, as in 头, 题, 顶: to turn the head and look.
厄 stands in for 雇 (gù) in the traditional 顧; the clue is only loose today.
大 (big) — an extra stroke below emphasises it: bigger than big, too much. 太 also sounds out 泰 tài.
耳 (ear) — hearing, as in 听, 闻, 联: sharp ears, then quick-witted.
总 (zǒng) is a close sound clue for cōng; also in 葱 cōng.
